releases.body:
## What's Changed

- release: prepare v0.4.21 (#765)
- Use the stable Jev alias and relocate evaluation docs (#761)
- Add optional Jev reranking and bilingual evaluation (#758)
- fix: prevent read paths from creating missing collections (#760)
- fix: search growing rows on Milvus Server (#757)
- fix(codex): filter composite host instruction envelopes (#754)
- fix(codex): parse response-item rollout messages safely (#751)
- fix(openclaw): update prompt hook compatibility (#744)

## What's Changed

- release: prepare v0.4.20 (#741)
- fix(dsh): snapshotEvents compat and stdin EOF for headless summarizer (#737)
- docs(plugin): explain model selection for forked skills (#733)
- fix(config): respect configured collection priority (#726)
- fix(hooks): avoid reindexing Milvus Lite on every plugin stop (#723)
- fix: clarify memory recall status messages (#722)
- fix(opencode): omit turn text when summaries fail (#719)
- perf(hooks): refresh the PyPI check off the session-start blocking path (#676) (#695)
- fix: enable best-effort Milvus Lite on Windows (#713)
- docs: route releases through repository skill (#712)
- fix: preserve latest session memory within context budget (#691)
- chore(release): bump plugin versions for single-source skills (#711)
- refactor(skills): single-source memory-config and memory-to-skill across platforms (#710)
- fix(opencode): run derive-collection.sh via argv, not a shell string (#681) (#682)
- ci: automate DSH plugin releases (#702)
- chore(dsh): release 0.1.3 (#701)

## What's Changed

- Bump versions for 0.4.19 release (#700)
- docs: use Codex product name consistently (#699)
- docs: add DeepSeek Harness plugin documentation (#698)
- fix(dsh): harden memsearch browser preview (#697)
- feat(dsh): add collapsible review dock and read-only .memsearch browser (#696)
- feat(dsh): add skill-candidate review panel UI to the web composer dock (#694)
- chore(dsh): release @zilliz/memsearch-dsh 0.1.1 (#690)
- feat(dsh): background maintenance (PROJECT.md/USER.md, skill distillation) (#689)
- fix(dsh): patch name must match npm package name (#688)
- chore(dsh): publish as @zilliz/memsearch-dsh (#687)

## What's Changed

- chore(release): bump version to 0.4.18 (#686)
- feat(dsh): auto summarize mode aligned with other platform plugins (#685)
- feat(dsh): add DeepSeek Harness platform plugin (#680)
- Cache the PyPI version check and resolve version from dist-info (#654)
- fix: decode OpenCode MemSearch output as UTF-8 (#678)
- fix: configure CLI streams for UTF-8 output (#662)
- fix(compact): don't crash when Anthropic returns a thinking block first (#675)
- fix(store): don't report every local open failure as a version mismatch (#663)
- fix: tolerate prose around maintenance JSON responses (#669)
- fix(claude-code): avoid raw transcript fallback (#674)

## What's Changed

- Bump versions for 0.4.17 release (#661)
- fix(skills): preserve newest journals in distill prompts (#660)
- fix: preserve newest journal entries within prompt budget (#656)
- fix(openclaw): honor MEMSEARCH_DIR for storage scope (#648)
- fix(claude-code): write session heading lazily to avoid stub journals (#640)

issues.title: [claude-code plugin] 0.4.20 regression on Windows: Win32 `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` treated as relative → `.memsearch` created under `<repo>/D:/…`, collection hash changes
help: background maintenance tasks fail on non-OpenAI-native chat providers (minimax M3 returns thinking-prefixed text, not JSON)
Claude Code SessionStart hook still hits `timeout: 10` after #645 — `--version` is a second full CLI boot and the PyPI check blocks (~3.4s of ~4.9s is avoidable)
Windows: kill_orphaned_index can't reap native index processes (Git Bash) -> unbounded accumulation / OOM
